name: pr-review-toolkit
description: PR review workflow skills for Codex: parallel review passes, documented PR comments, Gemini integration, interactive resolution, and resolver-managed bounded fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Run parallel Codex PR reviews, document findings, integrate Gemini feedback, resolve issues, and fix selected code.
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for participating in the pr-review-toolkit workflow. codex-review-pass launches six read-only review subagents and returns a deduplicated bundle; pr-review-and-document publishes that bundle through the shared .pr-review-cache/pr-#.json contract; gemini-review-integrator merges Gemini Code Assist comments into the canonical review; pr-review-resolver discusses unresolved findings one by one, coordinates decisions, and owns status updates; codex-fix-worker is resolver-managed and only fixes selected code.
defaultPrompt: Run a Codex PR review and document the results
Integrate Gemini review comments with Codex
Resolve PR review findings with Codex
Fix one selected PR review issue
Update the canonical PR review comment
